improv_extras.concept: partition the particle field into Worley/Voronoi cells with bright crack borders and dim interiors — reads as cracked clay or cell tissue

v1.feedback: The cracked-lakebed concept reads immediately and the earth-tone palette is excellent — pure Goldsworthy restraint. Two improvements: (1) the flat disc-on-plane composition feels somewhat inert at the default camera; tilting the camera slightly more oblique (reduce Y, increase Z) would give the plates' plateH displacement more visible parallax and depth-read, and (2) the crack-settling animation is so slow it's nearly invisible — consider making the initial state slightly more closed so the widening registers within the first 10 seconds as a perceivable event rather than requiring a minute of attention.

v2.feedback: The palette and contemplative crack-settling motion are solid, but this reads as a fresh Worley cellular piece, not a chain morph of the parent 6lt (Molnar Désordres). A proper chain should carry forward the parent's grid-disorder DNA — e.g. start with a Molnar rectilinear grid whose cells warp into Worley polygons over time, so both ancestors are legible. Compositionally the flat disc seen from a steep oblique is serviceable but unambitious — tilting toward a shallower grazing angle or letting the plates curl upward at edges would give more depth and silhouette interest.
